newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK police on alert for four-legged border prowlers.
newsitem.headline: HK police on alert for four-legged border prowlers.

text.p: Police in Hong Kong have been put on high alert after two unidentified four-legged animals were sighted prowling the British territory's northern border with China.
The creatures were spotted on November 28 at Pak Fu Shan during routine police patrols using high-tech night vision equipment, a police spokeswoman said on Monday.
"Police saw those creatures through thermal images equipment used to detect illegal (human) immigrants... we still don't know what these animals are," she told Reuters.
The creatures had paws and were larger than a domestic cat or dog, Pearl television station quoted police as saying.
Alarmed residents in the area had been warned to be vigilant, the television reported.
Border police had been alerted and relevant authorities would be contacted if action was needed, the police spokeswoman said.
